description: Metadata catalog of public Alan Turing Institute pages about AI safety, AI governance, or AI policy. A row is stored only when a response is the page HTML and the title is taken from that response. A challenge page or a non-HTML response is not stored. Rights stay unknown unless that HTML states the Open Government Licence. Updated times are not publication dates. The publisher is The Alan Turing Institute. The institute is not a UK government publisher. This catalog is not a belief collector.
